mapper.select: SELECT membership.user_id, organization.organization_name AS name FROM sys_user_organization membership JOIN sys_organization organization ON organization.id = membership.organization_id WHERE membership.user_id IN #{userId} ORDER BY membership.user_id, organization.organization_name, organization.id
SELECT id FROM sys_user_organization WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND organization_id = #{organizationId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_organization (id, user_id, organization_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{organizationId})
mapper.select: SELECT organization_id FROM sys_user_organization WHERE user_id = #{userId}
